# ONNX Runtime

WASM-only runtime from npm `onnxruntime-web@1.29.0`, unmodified distribution files.
MIT license and upstream ThirdPartyNotices.txt included from the v1.29.0 tag.
Only the WASM JS module, Emscripten module and SIMD binary are deployed.
Runs in a dedicated local worker with one thread; no CDN requests at runtime.

https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.29.0/js/web
